```{=html}
<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
  function setAllTargetsBlank() {
    document.querySelectorAll('a.quarto-grid-link').forEach(function(link) {
      link.setAttribute('target', '_blank');
      link.setAttribute('rel', 'noopener noreferrer');
    });
  }
  setAllTargetsBlank();

  // Handle dynamic re-renders when filtering categories or sorting
  const observer = new MutationObserver(function() {
    setAllTargetsBlank();
  });
  const listingEl = document.getElementById('listing-listing');
  if (listingEl) {
    observer.observe(listingEl, { childList: true, subtree: true });
  }

  // Delegated click handler to guarantee target="_blank"
  document.addEventListener("click", function(e) {
    const link = e.target.closest('a.quarto-grid-link');
    if (link) {
      link.setAttribute('target', '_blank');
      link.setAttribute('rel', 'noopener noreferrer');
    }
  });
});
</script>
```
